subtitle: The Waterworks Ridge

briefing.text: Bryn has shown Mira the dry culvert mouth beneath the southern arch. Open its stone door to gain a passage through the ridge.
The recovered chest has equipped a fresh levy. Defeat the Circle’s road screen to gain access to the waterworks ridge. Mira knows the boundary stone can choke the road with thorns.

intro.text: The chest bought us another levy. Keep the casters behind the shields; those thorn shields tear apart anything that rushes them.
The ridge is closed, and our spears hold the road. Go back to your tomb.
Your roots are in my master’s ground. Break the screen. I will have someone show me a way through this ridge.

victory.text: The channel is dry from end to end. Our riders can come out behind the Circle’s line.
Bring the levy through. The cistern will be ours again before Vael can close this passage.

debrief: Mira has opened a dry service passage through the ridge. Bryn’s local agreement permits woodland auxiliaries while the grove remains uncut; the main levy remains skeletal.
